claims.text: The paper explores various machine learning models including Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), Recurrent Neural Network (RNN), Feed-Forward Neural Network (FFNN), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), and Logistic Regression.
Newer models such as TraceMiner, which uses an LSTM-RNN architecture, and FAKEDETECTOR for detecting fake news credibility are also explored.
The study also evaluates models like Support Vector Machine (SVM), Random Forest, and Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) for classification tasks.
